`genomeos/publication/web_layout.py`:

```python
"""Public web-bucket layout for the Atlas explorer's per-artifact data (design §11; fast-load and GCS
design 2026-10-07 §C.1–§C.2).

One pure module fixes every object key, header and origin, so the four tools that touch the bucket
cannot disagree: ``scripts/encode_atlas_web.py --with-downloads`` (download keys and the catalog
rewrite), ``scripts/publish_atlas_web.py`` (what is uploaded, with which headers),
``scripts/provision_atlas_web_bucket.py`` (the CORS policy) and ``scripts/check_atlas_web_data.py``
(what the deploy gate visits). No I/O and no network.

Keys are relative and content-addressed: the first 16 hex digits of the object's sha256 are the last
dot-segment before the extension, so an immutable ``Cache-Control`` can never pin stale bytes.
Digests are over decoded bytes; gzip is a transport encoding the publisher adds.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import re
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, TypeVar
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

OBJECT_PREFIX = "atlas/web/"
IMMUTABLE_CACHE_CONTROL = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
CONTENT_TYPES: Mapping[str, str] = {".gosa": "application/octet-stream", ".json": "application/json"}
DOWNLOAD_KINDS = ("surface", "observations", "manifest")
PRODUCTION_ORIGINS = (
    "https://genome-os.org",
    "https://www.genome-os.org",
)
LOCAL_ORIGINS = tuple(
    f"http://{host}:{port}" for host in ("localhost", "127.0.0.1") for port in (4321, 4322, 4323)
)

_DATA_KEY = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*")
_SHA256 = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}")
_BUCKET = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]")
_T = TypeVar("_T")


class WebLayoutError(ValueError):
    """A catalog, key, base or bucket that would publish or serve the wrong bytes. Always fatal."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DownloadCopy:
    """One canonical JSON file copied byte-for-byte from an export tree into the bucket layout."""

    source: str
    key: str
    sha256: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WebObject:
    """One artifact-base object: what the publisher uploads and the deploy gate checks."""

    key: str
    sha256: str
    decoded_bytes: int | None  # declared by the catalog (grids, web tiers, observations); else None
    content_type: str
    content_disposition: str | None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SiteObject:
    """One site-base file that stays in the Pages bundle (Natural Earth context, external caches)."""

    key: str
    sha256: str | None


def cors_policy() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """The bucket CORS document, exactly as ``gcloud storage buckets update --cors-file`` takes it."""
    return [
        {
            "origin": [*PRODUCTION_ORIGINS, *LOCAL_ORIGINS],
            "method": ["GET", "HEAD"],
            "responseHeader": ["Content-Length", "Content-Type", "Content-Encoding", "ETag"],
            "maxAgeSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ]


def assert_data_key(key: object) -> str:
    """A catalog key: relative, lower-case, no scheme, no leading '/', no '..' segment (§B.4)."""
    if not isinstance(key, str) or not _DATA_KEY.fullmatch(key) or ".." in key.split("/"):
        raise WebLayoutError(
            f"invalid data key {key!r}: expected a relative path matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*$ "
            "with no '..' segment"
        )
    return key


def assert_absolute_data_base(base: object) -> str:
    """The absolute half of the §B.4 base rule: https (or http on localhost/127.0.0.1), ends in '/'."""
    if not isinstance(base, str) or not base:
        raise WebLayoutError("the artifact data base is empty; set ATLAS_DATA_BASE_URL (design §C.1.4)")
    parts = urlsplit(base)
    local = parts.scheme == "http" and parts.hostname in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1"}
    if (
        (parts.scheme != "https" and not local)
        or not parts.netloc
        or parts.query
        or parts.fragment
        or not base.endswith("/")
    ):
        raise WebLayoutError(
            f"artifact data base {base!r} must be an absolute https:// URL "
            "(or http://localhost / http://127.0.0.1) ending in '/'"
        )
    return base


def assert_bucket_name(name: object) -> str:
    """A GCS bucket name (3-63 characters, lower case). It comes from a variable, never from git."""
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not _BUCKET.fullmatch(name) or ".." in name:
        raise WebLayoutError(f"invalid bucket name {name!r}; pass the ATLAS_DATA_BUCKET value")
    return name


def resolve_key(key: str, base: str) -> str:
    """``new URL(key, base).href`` for a validated key and an absolute base."""
    return urljoin(assert_absolute_data_base(base), assert_data_key(key))


def object_name(key: str) -> str:
    """The bucket object name for a catalog key."""
    return OBJECT_PREFIX + assert_data_key(key)


def content_type_for(key: str) -> str:
    suffix = key[key.rfind(".") :] if "." in key else ""
    if suffix not in CONTENT_TYPES:
        raise WebLayoutError(f"{key}: no published content type for {suffix!r}")
    return CONTENT_TYPES[suffix]


def download_key(artifact_id: str, model_version: str, data_version: str, kind: str, sha256: str) -> str:
    if kind not in DOWNLOAD_KINDS:
        raise WebLayoutError(f"unknown download kind {kind!r}; expected one of {DOWNLOAD_KINDS}")
    _require_sha256(f"{artifact_id} {kind}", sha256)
    return assert_data_key(
        f"downloads/{artifact_id}/{model_version}/{data_version}/{artifact_id}.{kind}.{sha256[:16]}.json"
    )


def download_disposition(artifact_id: str, kind: str) -> str:
    """Save under the canonical filename even though the key is content-addressed."""
    return f'attachment; filename="{artifact_id}.{kind}.json"'


def apply_download_layout(catalog: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], tuple[DownloadCopy, ...]]:
    """Rewrite ``surface_url``, ``observations_url`` and ``downloads.*.url`` to download keys.

    Every sha256 is unchanged because the files are copied, not re-serialised;
    ``observations_url`` and ``downloads.observations.url`` name the same object. Applied to its own
    output it is a no-op, which is how a tree downloaded from the bucket is re-encoded.
    """
    rewritten: dict[str, Any] = copy.deepcopy(dict(catalog))
    copies: dict[str, DownloadCopy] = {}
    for ref in rewritten["artifacts"]:
        downloads = ref["downloads"]
        for kind in DOWNLOAD_KINDS:
            entry = downloads.get(kind)
            if entry is None:
                if kind == "observations" and ref["observations_available"] is False:
                    continue
                raise WebLayoutError(f"{ref['id']}: downloads.{kind} is missing")
            key = download_key(ref["id"], ref["model_version"], ref["data_version"], kind, entry["sha256"])
            copies.setdefault(key, DownloadCopy(assert_data_key(entry["url"]), key, entry["sha256"]))
            entry["url"] = key
        _bind(ref, "surface", downloads.get("surface"))
        if ref["observations_available"]:
            _bind(ref, "observations", downloads.get("observations"))
    return rewritten, tuple(copies[key] for key in sorted(copies))


def artifact_objects(catalog: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[WebObject, ...]:
    """Every artifact-base object the catalog references, one per key, in key order."""
    found: dict[str, WebObject] = {}
    for grid in catalog["grids"].values():
        _merge(found, _web_object(grid["url"], grid["sha256"], grid["bytes"], None))
    for ref in catalog["artifacts"]:
        for tier in ("render", "detail"):
            entry = ref["web"][tier]
            _merge(found, _web_object(entry["url"], entry["sha256"], entry["bytes"], None))
        _merge(found, _web_object(ref["surface_url"], ref["surface_sha256"], None, None))
        if ref["observations_available"]:
            _merge(
                found,
                _web_object(
                    ref["observations_url"], ref["observations_sha256"], ref["observations_bytes"], None
                ),
            )
        for kind in DOWNLOAD_KINDS:
            entry = ref["downloads"].get(kind)
            if entry is None:
                continue
            declared = ref["observations_bytes"] if kind == "observations" else None
            disposition = download_disposition(ref["id"], kind)
            _merge(found, _web_object(entry["url"], entry["sha256"], declared, disposition))
    return tuple(found[key] for key in sorted(found))


def critical_objects(catalog: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[WebObject, ...]:
    """The default (first) artifact's grid, render tier and observations, which the gate GETs."""
    by_key = {item.key: item for item in artifact_objects(catalog)}
    ref = catalog["artifacts"][0]
    grid = catalog["grids"].get(ref["web"]["grid_sha256"])
    if grid is None:
        raise WebLayoutError(f"{ref['id']}: web.grid_sha256 names no catalog grid")
    keys = [grid["url"], ref["web"]["render"]["url"]]
    if ref["observations_available"]:
        keys.append(ref["observations_url"])
    return tuple(by_key[key] for key in keys)


def site_objects(catalog: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[SiteObject, ...]:
    """Every site-base file: Natural Earth context sources and external caches (with digests)."""
    found: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    for source in catalog["context_sources"]:
        found.setdefault(assert_data_key(source["url"]), None)
    for ref in catalog["artifacts"]:
        for resource in ref["external_resources"]:
            found[assert_data_key(resource["cache_url"])] = resource["cache_sha256"]
    return tuple(SiteObject(key, found[key]) for key in sorted(found))


def _bind(ref: dict[str, Any], kind: str, download: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> None:
    if download is None or ref[f"{kind}_sha256"] != download["sha256"]:
        raise WebLayoutError(
            f"{ref['id']}: {kind}_sha256 does not match downloads.{kind}.sha256; they must name one object"
        )
    ref[f"{kind}_url"] = download["url"]


def _web_object(key: object, sha256: object, declared: object, disposition: str | None) -> WebObject:
    checked_key = assert_data_key(key)
    checked_sha = _require_sha256(checked_key, sha256)
    content_type = content_type_for(checked_key)
    stem = checked_key.rsplit(".", 1)[0]
    if not stem.endswith(f".{checked_sha[:16]}"):
        raise WebLayoutError(
            f"{checked_key}: not content-addressed; immutable keys end in .{checked_sha[:16]} before "
            "the extension (design §C.2)"
        )
    if declared is not None and (type(declared) is not int or declared <= 0):
        raise WebLayoutError(f"{checked_key}: declared decoded size {declared!r} is not a positive integer")
    return WebObject(checked_key, checked_sha, declared, content_type, disposition)


def _merge(found: dict[str, WebObject], item: WebObject) -> None:
    existing = found.get(item.key)
    if existing is None:
        found[item.key] = item
        return
    if existing.sha256 != item.sha256:
        raise WebLayoutError(f"{item.key}: named with two digests ({existing.sha256}, {item.sha256})")
    found[item.key] = WebObject(
        item.key,
        item.sha256,
        _agree(item.key, "decoded size", existing.decoded_bytes, item.decoded_bytes),
        item.content_type,
        _agree(item.key, "content disposition", existing.content_disposition, item.content_disposition),
    )


def _agree(key: str, what: str, first: _T | None, second: _T | None) -> _T | None:
    if first is not None and second is not None and first != second:
        raise WebLayoutError(f"{key}: two declared {what}s ({first!r}, {second!r})")
    return first if first is not None else second


def _require_sha256(where: str, sha256: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(sha256, str) or not _SHA256.fullmatch(sha256):
        raise WebLayoutError(f"{where}: invalid sha256 {sha256!r}")
    return sha256
```

`scripts/atlas_web_staging.py`:

```python
"""Write the download copies of an Atlas web staging tree (fast-load/GCS design 2026-10-07 §C.2).

Thin I/O beside ``genomeos.publication.web_layout.apply_download_layout``: each canonical JSON file is
copied byte-for-byte to its content-addressed download key after its sha256 is checked against the
catalog. A key that already exists must hold identical bytes; anything else is a hard error.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import sys
from collections.abc import Iterable
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from genomeos.publication.web_layout import DownloadCopy  # noqa: E402


class StagingError(RuntimeError):
    """A staged file would not be the bytes the catalog names."""


def write_download_copies(in_dir: Path, out_dir: Path, copies: Iterable[DownloadCopy]) -> list[Path]:
    """Copy every download into ``out_dir`` at its key; return the paths written by this call."""
    written: list[Path] = []
    for item in copies:
        source = in_dir / item.source
        if not source.is_file():
            raise StagingError(f"{item.source}: missing from the export directory {in_dir}")
        data = source.read_bytes()
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        if digest != item.sha256:
            raise StagingError(f"{item.source}: sha256 {digest} does not match the catalog digest {item.sha256}")
        target = out_dir / item.key
        if target.exists():
            if target.read_bytes() != data:
                raise StagingError(
                    f"{item.key}: already staged with different bytes; content-addressed keys never change"
                )
            continue
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(data)
        written.append(target)
    return written
```

```python
def _refuse_unsafe_staging(in_dir: Path, out_dir: Path) -> None:
    """--with-downloads writes the ~600 MB bucket staging tree: never into the export tree or Pages."""
    resolved_in, resolved_out = in_dir.resolve(), out_dir.resolve()
    public = (ROOT / "website" / "public").resolve()
    if resolved_out == resolved_in or resolved_in in resolved_out.parents:
        raise SystemExit(
            "encode_atlas_web: --with-downloads writes the bucket staging tree; pass an --out outside --in"
        )
    if resolved_out == public or public in resolved_out.parents:
        raise SystemExit(
            "encode_atlas_web: --with-downloads must not stage into website/public (it would ship to Pages)"
        )
```

`tests/fake_gcloud.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Stateful stand-in for the gcloud CLI in the Atlas web bucket tests (design 2026-10-07 §C.3).

It implements exactly the commands scripts/provision_atlas_web_bucket.py and
scripts/publish_atlas_web.py issue and exits 2 on anything else, so a script that drifts to an
untested command fails its tests instead of passing them. Error text mirrors gcloud 498's formats
("gs://… not found: 404.", "HTTPError 412: …"). State is the JSON file named by FAKE_GCLOUD_STATE;
every invocation is appended to the JSON-lines file named by FAKE_GCLOUD_LOG with the CLOUDSDK_CONFIG
it saw, which proves the call went through scripts/gcloud_repo.py.

State keys: buckets{name: resource + "bindings"}, objects{"bucket/name": resource + "data_b64"},
org_policies{constraint: policy}, org_policy_errors[constraint], race{"bucket/name": resource},
corrupt_uploads (bool), compute{collection: {name: resource}}, project_number (str; the number
`projects describe` reports and `buckets create` stamps, default DEFAULT_PROJECT_NUMBER).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

UNSUPPORTED = 2
DESCRIBE_FLAGS = {"raw": "", "format": "json"}
DEFAULT_PROJECT_NUMBER = "123456789012"


def _split(arguments: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, str]]:
    positional: list[str] = []
    flags: dict[str, str] = {}
    for argument in arguments:
        if argument.startswith("--"):
            name, _, value = argument[2:].partition("=")
            flags[name] = value
        else:
            positional.append(argument)
    return positional, flags


def _fail(message: str, code: int = 1) -> int:
    print(f"ERROR: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
    return code


def _unsupported(positional: list[str], flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    return _fail(f"fake gcloud: unsupported command {' '.join(positional)} {sorted(flags)}", UNSUPPORTED)


def _gs(url: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if not url.startswith("gs://"):
        raise SystemExit(_fail(f"fake gcloud: not a gs:// URL: {url}", UNSUPPORTED))
    bucket, _, name = url[len("gs://") :].partition("/")
    return bucket, name


def _print(value: Any) -> int:
    print(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


def _object_describe(state: dict[str, Any], url: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    if flags != DESCRIBE_FLAGS:
        return _unsupported(["storage", "objects", "describe", url], flags)
    bucket, name = _gs(url)
    found = state.get("objects", {}).get(f"{bucket}/{name}")
    if found is None:
        return _fail(f"(gcloud.storage.objects.describe) {url} not found: 404.")
    return _print({key: value for key, value in found.items() if key != "data_b64"})


def _copy(state: dict[str, Any], source: str, url: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    if any(name.startswith("gzip") for name in flags):
        return _fail("fake gcloud: --gzip-* sets Cache-Control no-transform; never use it", UNSUPPORTED)
    if flags.get("if-generation-match") != "0":
        return _fail("fake gcloud: uploads must pass --if-generation-match=0", UNSUPPORTED)
    bucket, name = _gs(url)
    if bucket not in state.get("buckets", {}):
        return _fail(f"(gcloud.storage.cp) gs://{bucket} not found: 404.")
    path = f"{bucket}/{name}"
    objects = state.setdefault("objects", {})
    raced = state.get("race", {}).pop(path, None)
    if raced is not None:
        objects[path] = raced
    if path in objects:
        return _fail("HTTPError 412: At least one of the pre-conditions you specified did not hold.")
    data = Path(source).read_bytes()
    stored = data + b"!" if state.get("corrupt_uploads") else data
    metadata = dict(item.split("=", 1) for item in flags.get("custom-metadata", "").split(",") if item)
    resource: dict[str, Any] = {
        "bucket": bucket,
        "name": name,
        "generation": "1",
        "size": str(len(stored)),
        "md5Hash": base64.b64encode(hashlib.md5(stored).digest()).decode("ascii"),
        "contentType": flags.get("content-type", "application/octet-stream"),
        "metadata": metadata,
        "data_b64": base64.b64encode(stored).decode("ascii"),
    }
    for flag, field in (
        ("content-encoding", "contentEncoding"),
        ("cache-control", "cacheControl"),
        ("content-disposition", "contentDisposition"),
    ):
        if flag in flags:
            resource[field] = flags[flag]
    objects[path] = resource
    return 0


def _bucket(state: dict[str, Any], url: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    bucket, _ = _gs(url)
    return state.get("buckets", {}).get(bucket)


def _org_enforces_pap(state: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    policy = state.get("org_policies", {}).get("storage.publicAccessPrevention", {})
    return any(rule.get("enforce") is True for rule in policy.get("spec", {}).get("rules", []))


def _bucket_describe(state: dict[str, Any], url: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    if flags != DESCRIBE_FLAGS:
        return _unsupported(["storage", "buckets", "describe", url], flags)
    found = _bucket(state, url)
    if found is None:
        return _fail(f"(gcloud.storage.buckets.describe) {url} not found: 404.")
    return _print({key: value for key, value in found.items() if key != "bindings"})


def _bucket_create(state: dict[str, Any], url: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    expected = {"project", "location", "uniform-bucket-level-access", "no-public-access-prevention"}
    if set(flags) != expected:
        return _unsupported(["storage", "buckets", "create", url], flags)
    bucket, _ = _gs(url)
    buckets = state.setdefault("buckets", {})
    if bucket in buckets:
        return _fail("HTTPError 409: The requested bucket name is not available.")
    # gcloud 498 `buckets create` has no labels flag: the provisioning script labels in a separate update.
    buckets[bucket] = {
        "name": bucket,
        "location": flags["location"].upper(),
        "projectNumber": state.get("project_number", DEFAULT_PROJECT_NUMBER),
        "iamConfiguration": {
            "uniformBucketLevelAccess": {"enabled": True},
            "publicAccessPrevention": "enforced" if _org_enforces_pap(state) else "inherited",
        },
        "bindings": [],
    }
    return 0


def _bucket_update(state: dict[str, Any], url: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    allowed = {"cors-file", "uniform-bucket-level-access", "no-public-access-prevention", "no-versioning", "update-labels"}
    if not flags or not set(flags) <= allowed:
        return _unsupported(["storage", "buckets", "update", url], flags)
    found = _bucket(state, url)
    if found is None:
        return _fail(f"(gcloud.storage.buckets.update) {url} not found: 404.")
    if "no-public-access-prevention" in flags and _org_enforces_pap(state):
        return _fail("HTTPError 412: Public access prevention is enforced by an organization policy.")
    if "update-labels" in flags:
        labels = found.setdefault("labels", {})
        for item in flags["update-labels"].split(","):
            key, _, value = item.partition("=")
            labels[key] = value
    if "cors-file" in flags:
        found["cors"] = json.loads(Path(flags["cors-file"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    iam = found.setdefault("iamConfiguration", {})
    if "uniform-bucket-level-access" in flags:
        iam["uniformBucketLevelAccess"] = {"enabled": True}
    if "no-public-access-prevention" in flags:
        iam["publicAccessPrevention"] = "inherited"
    if "no-versioning" in flags:
        found["versioning"] = {"enabled": False}
    return 0


def _iam_get(state: dict[str, Any], url: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    if flags != {"format": "json"}:
        return _unsupported(["storage", "buckets", "get-iam-policy", url], flags)
    found = _bucket(state, url)
    if found is None:
        return _fail(f"(gcloud.storage.buckets.get-iam-policy) {url} not found: 404.")
    return _print({"bindings": found.get("bindings", []), "etag": "CAE="})


def _iam_add(state: dict[str, Any], url: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    if set(flags) != {"member", "role"}:
        return _unsupported(["storage", "buckets", "add-iam-policy-binding", url], flags)
    found = _bucket(state, url)
    if found is None:
        return _fail(f"(gcloud.storage.buckets.add-iam-policy-binding) {url} not found: 404.")
    drs = state.get("org_policies", {}).get("iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains", {})
    restricted = any(rule.get("values", {}).get("allowedValues") for rule in drs.get("spec", {}).get("rules", []))
    if flags["member"] == "allUsers" and restricted:
        return _fail("HTTPError 412: One or more users named in the policy do not belong to a permitted customer.")
    bindings = found.setdefault("bindings", [])
    for binding in bindings:
        if binding["role"] == flags["role"]:
            if flags["member"] not in binding["members"]:
                binding["members"].append(flags["member"])
            return 0
    bindings.append({"role": flags["role"], "members": [flags["member"]]})
    return 0


def _org_policy(state: dict[str, Any], constraint: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    if set(flags) != {"project", "effective", "format"} or flags["format"] != "json":
        return _unsupported(["org-policies", "describe", constraint], flags)
    if constraint in state.get("org_policy_errors", []):
        return _fail(f"(gcloud.org-policies.describe) PERMISSION_DENIED: orgpolicy.policy.get on {constraint}")
    default = {"name": f"projects/{flags['project']}/policies/{constraint}", "spec": {}}
    return _print(state.get("org_policies", {}).get(constraint, default))


def _project_describe(state: dict[str, Any], project: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    if flags != {"format": "json"}:
        return _unsupported(["projects", "describe", project], flags)
    return _print(
        {
            "lifecycleState": "ACTIVE",
            "projectId": project,
            "projectNumber": state.get("project_number", DEFAULT_PROJECT_NUMBER),
        }
    )


def _compute_describe(state: dict[str, Any], collection: str, name: str) -> int:
    found = state.get("compute", {}).get(collection, {}).get(name)
    if found is None:
        return _fail(f"(gcloud.compute.{collection}.describe) Could not fetch resource: '{name}' was not found")
    return _print(found)


def _compute_create(state: dict[str, Any], collection: str, name: str, flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    resources = state.setdefault("compute", {}).setdefault(collection, {})
    if name in resources:
        return _fail(f"(gcloud.compute.{collection}.create) '{name}' already exists")
    resource: dict[str, Any] = {"name": name, **flags}
    if collection == "addresses":
        resource["address"] = "203.0.113.10"
    resources[name] = resource
    return 0


def _dispatch(state: dict[str, Any], positional: list[str], flags: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    match positional:
        case ["storage", "objects", "describe", url]:
            return _object_describe(state, url, flags)
        case ["storage", "cp", source, url]:
            return _copy(state, source, url, flags)
        case ["storage", "buckets", "describe", url]:
            return _bucket_describe(state, url, flags)
        case ["storage", "buckets", "create", url]:
            return _bucket_create(state, url, flags)
        case ["storage", "buckets", "update", url]:
            return _bucket_update(state, url, flags)
        case ["storage", "buckets", "get-iam-policy", url]:
            return _iam_get(state, url, flags)
        case ["storage", "buckets", "add-iam-policy-binding", url]:
            return _iam_add(state, url, flags)
        case ["org-policies", "describe", constraint]:
            return _org_policy(state, constraint, flags)
        case ["projects", "describe", project]:
            return _project_describe(state, project, flags)
        case ["compute", collection, "describe", name]:
            return _compute_describe(state, collection, name)
        case ["compute", collection, "create", name]:
            return _compute_create(state, collection, name, flags)
        case _:
            return _unsupported(positional, flags)


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    state_path = Path(os.environ["FAKE_GCLOUD_STATE"])
    with open(os.environ["FAKE_GCLOUD_LOG"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as log:
        log.write(json.dumps({"argv": argv, "cloudsdk_config": os.environ.get("CLOUDSDK_CONFIG")}) + "\n")
    state = json.loads(state_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    positional, flags = _split(argv)
    code = _dispatch(state, positional, flags)
    state_path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
    return code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
```

```python
FAKE_GCLOUD = Path(__file__).with_name("fake_gcloud.py")
MUTATING_VERBS = {"create", "update", "add-iam-policy-binding", "cp"}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FakeGcloud:
    """Handle on tests/fake_gcloud.py's state and call log for one test."""

    state_path: Path
    log_path: Path

    def state(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return json.loads(self.state_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def write_state(self, state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.state_path.write_text(json.dumps(state), encoding="utf-8")

    def _records(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        if not self.log_path.exists():
            return []
        return [json.loads(line) for line in self.log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]

    def calls(self) -> list[list[str]]:
        return [record["argv"] for record in self._records()]

    def configs(self) -> set[str | None]:
        return {record["cloudsdk_config"] for record in self._records()}

    def mutating_calls(self) -> list[list[str]]:
        return [call for call in self.calls() if MUTATING_VERBS & set(call[:4])]


def install_fake_gcloud(
    root: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, state: dict[str, Any] | None = None
) -> FakeGcloud:
    """Point scripts/gcloud_repo.py at tests/fake_gcloud.py through GENOMEOS_GCLOUD_EXECUTABLE."""
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shim = root / "fake-gcloud"
    shim.write_text(
        f'#!/bin/sh\nexec {shlex.quote(sys.executable)} {shlex.quote(str(FAKE_GCLOUD))} "$@"\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    shim.chmod(0o755)
    fake = FakeGcloud(root / "fake-gcloud-state.json", root / "fake-gcloud-log.jsonl")
    fake.write_state(json.loads(json.dumps(state or {})))
    monkeypatch.setenv("GENOMEOS_GCLOUD_EXECUTABLE", str(shim))
    monkeypatch.setenv("FAKE_GCLOUD_STATE", str(fake.state_path))
    monkeypatch.setenv("FAKE_GCLOUD_LOG", str(fake.log_path))
    return fake
```

```python
"""Repository-wrapped gcloud calls for the Atlas web bucket scripts (design 2026-10-07 §C.2).

Every command runs as ``python scripts/gcloud_repo.py run …`` so it uses the repository-local SDK
configuration (docs/repo-gcloud-auth.md); bare ``gcloud`` is never invoked. The wrapper honours
``GENOMEOS_GCLOUD_EXECUTABLE``, which is how the tests substitute tests/fake_gcloud.py. In dry-run
nothing is executed: every command is printed, reads report "absent" and mutations report success, so
the printed plan is the complete sequence for a fresh bucket.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, TextIO

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
WRAPPER = ROOT / "scripts" / "gcloud_repo.py"
_NOT_FOUND = re.compile(r"\b404\b|not ?found", re.IGNORECASE)  # "gs://b/o not found: 404."
_PRECONDITION = re.compile(r"\b412\b|precondition", re.IGNORECASE)  # "HTTPError 412: …"


class GcloudError(RuntimeError):
    """A gcloud command failed for a reason the caller does not handle."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GcloudResult:
    returncode: int
    stdout: str
    stderr: str

    @property
    def not_found(self) -> bool:
        return self.returncode != 0 and bool(_NOT_FOUND.search(self.stderr))

    @property
    def precondition_failed(self) -> bool:
        return self.returncode != 0 and bool(_PRECONDITION.search(self.stderr))


class Gcloud:
    """Runs wrapped gcloud commands, or only prints them when ``dry_run`` is set."""

    def __init__(self, *, dry_run: bool, out: TextIO | None = None) -> None:
        self.dry_run = dry_run
        self._out = out

    @staticmethod
    def display(arguments: Sequence[str]) -> str:
        return shlex.join(["python", "scripts/gcloud_repo.py", "run", *arguments])

    def describe(self, arguments: Sequence[str]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        """Parsed JSON from a read; ``None`` when gcloud reports 404 (and always in dry-run)."""
        if self.dry_run:
            self._say("DRY-RUN", arguments)
            return None
        result = self._execute(arguments)
        if result.returncode == 0:
            value = json.loads(result.stdout or "null")
            if not isinstance(value, dict):
                raise GcloudError(f"{self.display(arguments)} printed {result.stdout[:200]!r}, not a JSON object")
            return value
        if result.not_found:
            return None
        raise GcloudError(f"{self.display(arguments)} failed ({result.returncode}): {result.stderr.strip()}")

    def query(self, arguments: Sequence[str]) -> GcloudResult:
        """A read whose failure the caller reports itself (an unreadable org policy, say)."""
        if self.dry_run:
            self._say("DRY-RUN", arguments)
            return GcloudResult(0, "{}", "")
        return self._execute(arguments)

    def mutate(self, arguments: Sequence[str]) -> GcloudResult:
        """A change; printed as ``RUN …`` (an audit line) or ``DRY-RUN …`` before it happens."""
        self._say("DRY-RUN" if self.dry_run else "RUN", arguments)
        if self.dry_run:
            return GcloudResult(0, "", "")
        return self._execute(arguments)

    def _say(self, tag: str, arguments: Sequence[str]) -> None:
        print(f"{tag} {self.display(arguments)}", file=self._out if self._out is not None else sys.stdout)

    def _execute(self, arguments: Sequence[str]) -> GcloudResult:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(WRAPPER), "run", *arguments],
            cwd=ROOT,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
        return GcloudResult(completed.returncode, completed.stdout, completed.stderr)
```

**Branch:** `feat/atlas-gcs-web-data`   **Depends on:** Task 86 (C1), Task 88 (C3)
**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/provision_atlas_web_bucket.py`
- Test: `tests/test_provision_atlas_web_bucket.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Gcloud`, `GcloudError` (C3); `OBJECT_PREFIX`, `cors_policy`, `assert_bucket_name`
  (C1); `deploy/atlas-web-cors.json`.
- Produces: CLI `python scripts/provision_atlas_web_bucket.py --mode edge|cloud-cdn [--dry-run]
  --bucket NAME [--project ID]` (project default `$GENOMEOS_GCP_PROJECT`); prints a report and
  `artifact base: <url>`; exit 0 ok, 1 blocked/failed (including an existing bucket this script did
  not create), 2 usage; the ownership label `genomeos-purpose=atlas-web` (`LABEL_KEY`, `LABEL_VALUE`),
  set right after creation; `assert_created_here(gcloud, url, project, current)`.

**Safety rule.** Provisioning makes a bucket public (`allUsers` objectViewer, which includes anonymous
listing; public-access prevention not enforced; CORS replaced). So an existing bucket is adopted only
when it carries the label this script sets at creation **and** its `projectNumber` equals the
project's; otherwise the script raises before any change (`needs-human-decision`). It never passes
`--no-public-access-prevention` on an update: an existing (or just-created) bucket that reports
public-access prevention `enforced` stops the run with exit 1. Versioning is disabled only on a
labelled bucket.

**Spec:** §C.2 (us-east1, uniform access, `allUsers: roles/storage.objectViewer`, PAP and
domain-restricted-sharing checks reported, no versioning, default soft delete, nothing deleted; CORS
via `--cors-file`; modes edge provisioned / cloud-cdn scripted; DNS at GoDaddy is a human step).

```python
"""Provisioning the public Atlas web bucket (design 2026-10-07 §C.2, §C.3)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shlex
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from genomeos.publication.web_layout import cors_policy
from scripts import provision_atlas_web_bucket as provision
from tests.atlas_web_fixtures import install_fake_gcloud

PROJECT = "example-project"
PROJECT_NUMBER = "123456789012"
BUCKET = "example-bucket"
URL = f"gs://{BUCKET}"
POLICIES = [
    ["org-policies", "describe", "iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains", f"--project={PROJECT}", "--effective", "--format=json"],
    ["org-policies", "describe", "storage.publicAccessPrevention", f"--project={PROJECT}", "--effective", "--format=json"],
]
DESCRIBE = ["storage", "buckets", "describe", URL, "--raw", "--format=json"]
CREATE = [
    "storage", "buckets", "create", URL, f"--project={PROJECT}", "--location=us-east1",
    "--uniform-bucket-level-access", "--no-public-access-prevention",
]
LABEL = ["storage", "buckets", "update", URL, "--update-labels=genomeos-purpose=atlas-web"]
PROJECT_DESCRIBE = ["projects", "describe", PROJECT, "--format=json"]
IAM_GET = ["storage", "buckets", "get-iam-policy", URL, "--format=json"]
IAM_ADD = ["storage", "buckets", "add-iam-policy-binding", URL, "--member=allUsers", "--role=roles/storage.objectViewer"]
CORS = ["storage", "buckets", "update", URL, "--cors-file=deploy/atlas-web-cors.json"]
EDGE_PLAN = [*POLICIES, DESCRIBE, CREATE, LABEL, DESCRIBE, IAM_GET, IAM_ADD, CORS]


def _existing(**fields: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Fake state with one same-project bucket this script created (labelled), overridden by ``fields``."""
    bucket: dict[str, object] = {
        "name": BUCKET,
        "location": "US-EAST1",
        "projectNumber": PROJECT_NUMBER,
        "labels": {"genomeos-purpose": "atlas-web"},
        "iamConfiguration": {"uniformBucketLevelAccess": {"enabled": True}, "publicAccessPrevention": "inherited"},
        "bindings": [],
    }
    bucket.update(fields)
    return {"project_number": PROJECT_NUMBER, "buckets": {BUCKET: bucket}}


def _dry(arguments: list[str]) -> str:
    return "DRY-RUN " + shlex.join(["python", "scripts/gcloud_repo.py", "run", *arguments])


def _provision(*extra: str) -> int:
    return provision.main(["--bucket", BUCKET, "--project", PROJECT, *extra])


def test_dry_run_prints_the_full_edge_plan_and_runs_nothing(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path, monkeypatch, {})
    assert _provision("--dry-run") == 0
    lines = capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines()
    assert [line for line in lines if line.startswith("DRY-RUN ")] == [_dry(step) for step in EDGE_PLAN]
    assert fake.calls() == []
    assert lines[-1] == f"artifact base: https://storage.googleapis.com/{BUCKET}/atlas/web/"


def test_edge_creates_a_public_us_east1_bucket_with_the_cors_policy(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path, monkeypatch, {})
    assert _provision() == 0
    assert fake.calls() == EDGE_PLAN
    bucket = fake.state()["buckets"][BUCKET]
    assert bucket["location"] == "US-EAST1"
    assert bucket["iamConfiguration"] == {
        "uniformBucketLevelAccess": {"enabled": True},
        "publicAccessPrevention": "inherited",
    }
    assert bucket["bindings"] == [{"role": "roles/storage.objectViewer", "members": ["allUsers"]}]
    assert bucket["cors"] == cors_policy()
    assert bucket["labels"] == {"genomeos-purpose": "atlas-web"}
    assert "versioning" not in bucket
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert "public-access prevention: inherited" in out
    assert "org policy iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains: does not block public objects" in out


def test_a_second_run_changes_nothing(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path, monkeypatch, {})
    assert _provision() == 0
    first = len(fake.calls())
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert _provision() == 0
    assert fake.calls()[first:] == [*POLICIES, DESCRIBE, PROJECT_DESCRIBE, IAM_GET]
    assert "RUN " not in capsys.readouterr().out


def test_an_unlabelled_bucket_in_the_project_is_never_touched(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    # e.g. a private staging or Cloud Run artifact bucket that happens to have the chosen name
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _existing(labels={}))
    assert _provision() == 1
    assert "not created by this script" in capsys.readouterr().err
    assert fake.mutating_calls() == []


def test_a_labelled_bucket_with_enforced_public_access_prevention_stops(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    enforced = {"uniformBucketLevelAccess": {"enabled": True}, "publicAccessPrevention": "enforced"}
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _existing(iamConfiguration=enforced))
    assert _provision() == 1
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert "public-access prevention: enforced" in captured.out
    assert "never lifts it" in captured.err
    assert fake.mutating_calls() == []


def test_a_bucket_in_another_project_is_never_touched(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _existing(projectNumber="999999999999"))
    assert _provision() == 1
    assert f"is not in project {PROJECT}" in capsys.readouterr().err
    assert fake.mutating_calls() == []


def test_a_labelled_bucket_that_drifted_gets_only_the_allowed_update(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    drifted = {"uniformBucketLevelAccess": {"enabled": False}, "publicAccessPrevention": "inherited"}
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path, monkeypatch, _existing(iamConfiguration=drifted, versioning={"enabled": True}))
    assert _provision() == 0
    update = ["storage", "buckets", "update", URL, "--uniform-bucket-level-access", "--no-versioning"]
    assert fake.mutating_calls() == [update, IAM_ADD, CORS]
    assert all("--no-public-access-prevention" not in call for call in fake.mutating_calls())
    bucket = fake.state()["buckets"][BUCKET]
    assert bucket["versioning"] == {"enabled": False}
    assert bucket["iamConfiguration"]["publicAccessPrevention"] == "inherited"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(

    [
        ("iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains", {"spec": {"rules": [{"values": {"allowedValues": ["C0abc123"]}}]}}),
```

- [ ] Step 3: Implement `scripts/provision_atlas_web_bucket.py`.

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Provision the public GCS bucket that serves the Atlas web data (fast-load/GCS design 2026-10-07 §C.2).

Idempotent: every step reads the current state first and changes only what differs, so a second run
changes nothing. ``--dry-run`` prints every command and runs none; because it reads nothing, it prints
the full sequence for a new bucket. Nothing here deletes anything.

``edge`` (default; provisioned): public objects with ``Cache-Control: public`` are served from
Google's edge caches at ``https://storage.googleapis.com/<bucket>/atlas/web/``.

``cloud-cdn`` (scripted, not provisioned): a backend bucket with Cloud CDN behind a global external
HTTPS load balancer with a Google-managed certificate for ``data.genome-os.org``. It needs a DNS A
record at the registrar (GoDaddy; a human step) and has a recurring load-balancer cost.

The bucket is in us-east1 with uniform bucket-level access, readable by ``allUsers``
(``roles/storage.objectViewer``), unversioned (keys are content-addressed) with the default soft
delete. Effective domain-restricted-sharing and public-access-prevention org policies are read and
reported first; a blocking one stops the run before any change. Because this makes a bucket public,
an existing bucket is adopted only if it carries the ``genomeos-purpose=atlas-web`` label this
script sets right after creating it and belongs to the project; any other existing bucket is
refused before any change (needs-human-decision), and public-access prevention is never lifted on
an update. No project id or bucket name is
stored in git (docs/repo-gcloud-auth.md): pass ``--bucket`` and ``--project`` (or
``GENOMEOS_GCP_PROJECT``). Every command goes through scripts/gcloud_repo.py.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from genomeos.publication.web_layout import OBJECT_PREFIX, assert_bucket_name, cors_policy  # noqa: E402
from scripts.atlas_web_gcloud import Gcloud, GcloudError  # noqa: E402

# Relative to ROOT: the wrapper runs gcloud from the repository root, and the printed plan stays
# free of machine-specific paths.
CORS_FILE = Path("deploy") / "atlas-web-cors.json"
LOCATION = "us-east1"
PUBLIC_MEMBER = "allUsers"
PUBLIC_ROLE = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
DOMAIN_RESTRICTED_SHARING = "iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains"
PUBLIC_ACCESS_PREVENTION = "storage.publicAccessPrevention"
CDN_DOMAIN = "data.genome-os.org"
CDN_ADDRESS = "atlas-web-ip"
# Set right after creation (gcloud 498 `buckets create` has no labels flag); the proof that an
# existing bucket is one this script made, and so may be made public.
LABEL_KEY = "genomeos-purpose"
LABEL_VALUE = "atlas-web"
# What a bucket created by this script looks like; stands in for the describe a dry run cannot make.
NEW_BUCKET: dict[str, Any] = {
    "location": LOCATION.upper(),
    "iamConfiguration": {"uniformBucketLevelAccess": {"enabled": True}, "publicAccessPrevention": "inherited"},
}


class ProvisionError(RuntimeError):
    """The bucket cannot be made public as the design requires."""


def edge_base_url(bucket: str) -> str:
    return f"https://storage.googleapis.com/{bucket}/{OBJECT_PREFIX}"


def policy_blocks(constraint: str, policy: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """True when an effective org policy would stop ``allUsers`` from reading the objects."""
    rules = policy.get("spec", {}).get("rules", [])
    if constraint == PUBLIC_ACCESS_PREVENTION:
        return any(rule.get("enforce") is True for rule in rules)
    return any(rule.get("denyAll") is True or rule.get("values", {}).get("allowedValues") for rule in rules)


def check_org_policies(gcloud: Gcloud, project: str, report: list[str]) -> None:
    blocked: list[str] = []
    for constraint in (DOMAIN_RESTRICTED_SHARING, PUBLIC_ACCESS_PREVENTION):
        result = gcloud.query(
            ["org-policies", "describe", constraint, f"--project={project}", "--effective", "--format=json"]
        )
        if gcloud.dry_run:
            report.append(f"org policy {constraint}: not read (dry-run)")
            continue
        if result.returncode != 0:
            detail = result.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1] if result.stderr.strip() else "no detail"
            report.append(
                f"org policy {constraint}: unreadable ({detail}); "
                "a blocking policy will surface as a failed step"
            )
            continue
        if policy_blocks(constraint, json.loads(result.stdout or "{}")):
            blocked.append(constraint)
            report.append(f"org policy {constraint}: BLOCKS public objects")
        else:
            report.append(f"org policy {constraint}: does not block public objects")
    if blocked:
        raise ProvisionError(
            "effective organization policy blocks a public bucket: "
            + ", ".join(blocked)
            + "; an organization admin must grant a project exception (design §C.2)"
        )


def assert_created_here(gcloud: Gcloud, url: str, project: str, current: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Refuse, before any change, an existing bucket this script did not create (design §C.2).

    Provisioning grants ``allUsers`` read (and anonymous listing) on the whole bucket, so a
    same-named bucket without this script's label, or in another project, is never touched.
    """
    labels = current.get("labels") or {}
    if labels.get(LABEL_KEY) != LABEL_VALUE:
        raise ProvisionError(
            f"{url} exists but was not created by this script (no label {LABEL_KEY}={LABEL_VALUE}); "
            "it is never made public automatically: needs-human-decision"
        )
    project_info = gcloud.describe(["projects", "describe", project, "--format=json"]) or {}
    expected = str(project_info.get("projectNumber", ""))
    if not expected or str(current.get("projectNumber", "")) != expected:
        raise ProvisionError(
            f"{url} is not in project {project} (bucket project number "
            f"{current.get('projectNumber')!r}); needs-human-decision"
        )


def provision_edge(gcloud: Gcloud, bucket: str, project: str, report: list[str]) -> None:
    url = f"gs://{bucket}"
    committed = json.loads((ROOT / CORS_FILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if committed != cors_policy():
        raise ProvisionError(f"{CORS_FILE} differs from web_layout.cors_policy(); fix the file, not the bucket")
    check_org_policies(gcloud, project, report)
    describe = ["storage", "buckets", "describe", url, "--raw", "--format=json"]
    current = gcloud.describe(describe)
    created = current is None
    if current is None:
        _mutate(
            gcloud,
            [
                "storage", "buckets", "create", url, f"--project={project}", f"--location={LOCATION}",
                "--uniform-bucket-level-access", "--no-public-access-prevention",
            ],
        )
        _mutate(gcloud, ["storage", "buckets", "update", url, f"--update-labels={LABEL_KEY}={LABEL_VALUE}"])
        report.append(f"bucket {url}: created in {LOCATION}, labelled {LABEL_KEY}={LABEL_VALUE}")
        current = gcloud.describe(describe)
        if current is None:
            if not gcloud.dry_run:
                raise ProvisionError(f"{url} is not visible right after creation")
            current = dict(NEW_BUCKET)
    else:
        report.append(f"bucket {url}: exists")
    location = str(current.get("location", "")).lower()
    if location != LOCATION:
        raise ProvisionError(f"{url} is in {location or 'an unknown location'}, not {LOCATION}; choose another name")
    if not created:
        assert_created_here(gcloud, url, project, current)
    iam = current.get("iamConfiguration", {})
    prevention = iam.get("publicAccessPrevention", "inherited")
    report.append(f"public-access prevention: {prevention}")
    if prevention == "enforced":
        raise ProvisionError(
            f"public-access prevention is enforced on {url}; this script never lifts it "
            "(an organization policy or a deliberate setting): needs-human-decision"
        )
    updates: list[str] = []
    if not iam.get("uniformBucketLevelAccess", {}).get("enabled"):
        updates.append("--uniform-bucket-level-access")
    if current.get("versioning", {}).get("enabled"):
        updates.append("--no-versioning")
    if updates:
        _mutate(gcloud, ["storage", "buckets", "update", url, *updates])
        report.append(f"bucket {url}: updated {' '.join(updates)}")
    policy = gcloud.describe(["storage", "buckets", "get-iam-policy", url, "--format=json"]) or {"bindings": []}
    public = any(
        binding.get("role") == PUBLIC_ROLE and PUBLIC_MEMBER in binding.get("members", [])
        for binding in policy.get("bindings", [])
    )
    if public:
        report.append(f"IAM: {PUBLIC_MEMBER} already has {PUBLIC_ROLE}")
    else:
        _mutate(
            gcloud,
            ["storage", "buckets", "add-iam-policy-binding", url, f"--member={PUBLIC_MEMBER}", f"--role={PUBLIC_ROLE}"],
        )
        report.append(f"IAM: {PUBLIC_MEMBER} granted {PUBLIC_ROLE}")
    if current.get("cors") == committed:
        report.append("CORS: already the committed policy")
    else:
        _mutate(gcloud, ["storage", "buckets", "update", url, f"--cors-file={CORS_FILE}"])
        report.append(f"CORS: set from {CORS_FILE}")


def cdn_steps(bucket: str, project: str) -> list[tuple[list[str], list[str]]]:
    """(describe, create) argument pairs for the cloud-cdn resources, in dependency order."""
    scope = f"--project={project}"
    return [
        (
            ["compute", "backend-buckets", "describe", "atlas-web-backend", scope, "--format=json"],
            [
                "compute", "backend-buckets", "create", "atlas-web-backend", scope,
                f"--gcs-bucket-name={bucket}", "--enable-cdn", "--cache-mode=USE_ORIGIN_HEADERS",
            ],
        ),
        (
            ["compute", "url-maps", "describe", "atlas-web-map", "--global", scope, "--format=json"],
            ["compute", "url-maps", "create", "atlas-web-map", "--global", scope, "--default-backend-bucket=atlas-web-backend"],
        ),
        (
            ["compute", "ssl-certificates", "describe", "atlas-web-cert", "--global", scope, "--format=json"],
            ["compute", "ssl-certificates", "create", "atlas-web-cert", "--global", scope, f"--domains={CDN_DOMAIN}"],
        ),
        (
            ["compute", "target-https-proxies", "describe", "atlas-web-https-proxy", "--global", scope, "--format=json"],
            [
                "compute", "target-https-proxies", "create", "atlas-web-https-proxy", "--global", scope,
                "--url-map=atlas-web-map", "--ssl-certificates=atlas-web-cert",
            ],
        ),
        (
            ["compute", "addresses", "describe", CDN_ADDRESS, "--global", scope, "--format=json"],
            ["compute", "addresses", "create", CDN_ADDRESS, "--global", scope, "--ip-version=IPV4"],
        ),
        (
            ["compute", "forwarding-rules", "describe", "atlas-web-https-rule", "--global", scope, "--format=json"],
            [
                "compute", "forwarding-rules", "create", "atlas-web-https-rule", "--global", scope,
                "--load-balancing-scheme=EXTERNAL_MANAGED", "--target-https-proxy=atlas-web-https-proxy",
                f"--address={CDN_ADDRESS}", "--ports=443",
            ],
        ),
    ]


def provision_cloud_cdn(gcloud: Gcloud, bucket: str, project: str, report: list[str]) -> None:
    for describe, create in cdn_steps(bucket, project):
        label = f"cloud-cdn {create[1]} {create[3]}"
        if gcloud.describe(describe) is None:
            _mutate(gcloud, create)
            report.append(f"{label}: created")
        else:
            report.append(f"{label}: exists")
    address = gcloud.describe(
        ["compute", "addresses", "describe", CDN_ADDRESS, "--global", f"--project={project}", "--format=json"]
    )
    ip = address.get("address", "<address pending>") if address else "<address pending>"
    report.append(
        f"HUMAN STEP: create a DNS A record {CDN_DOMAIN} -> {ip} at the registrar (GoDaddy); the managed "
        f"certificate provisions only after it resolves. Then set ATLAS_DATA_BASE_URL=https://{CDN_DOMAIN}/{OBJECT_PREFIX}"
    )


def _mutate(gcloud: Gcloud, arguments: list[str]) -> None:
    result = gcloud.mutate(arguments)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise ProvisionError(f"{Gcloud.display(arguments)} failed: {result.stderr.strip()}")


def _bucket(value: str) -> str:
    try:
        return assert_bucket_name(value)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(str(error)) from error


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Provision the public GCS bucket for the Atlas web data.")
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=("edge", "cloud-cdn"), default="edge")
    parser.add_argument("--bucket", type=_bucket, required=True, help="bucket name (never stored in git)")
    parser.add_argument("--project", help="GCP project id (default: $GENOMEOS_GCP_PROJECT; never stored in git)")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="print every gcloud command and run none")
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    project = args.project or os.environ.get("GENOMEOS_GCP_PROJECT")
    if not project:
        print("error: pass --project or set GENOMEOS_GCP_PROJECT; project ids are not stored in git", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    gcloud = Gcloud(dry_run=args.dry_run)
    report: list[str] = []
    try:
        provision_edge(gcloud, args.bucket, project, report)
        if args.mode == "cloud-cdn":
            provision_cloud_cdn(gcloud, args.bucket, project, report)
    except (ProvisionError, GcloudError) as error:
        print("\n".join(report))
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("\n".join(report))
    base = edge_base_url(args.bucket) if args.mode == "edge" else f"https://{CDN_DOMAIN}/{OBJECT_PREFIX}"
    print(f"artifact base: {base}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

Note on ordering: the CORS file check runs before the org-policy reads (so a drifted file is
refused before any call); the test asserts no bucket update happened.

```python
"""Publishing the Atlas web staging tree (design 2026-10-07 §C.2, §C.3)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import shlex
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from genomeos.publication.web_layout import IMMUTABLE_CACHE_CONTROL, artifact_objects
from scripts import publish_atlas_web as publish
from tests.atlas_web_fixtures import flat_catalog, install_fake_gcloud, staged_catalog, write_staging

BUCKET = "example-bucket"
EMPTY_BUCKET: dict[str, Any] = {"buckets": {BUCKET: {"name": BUCKET, "location": "US-EAST1", "bindings": []}}}


def _dry(arguments: list[str]) -> str:
    return "DRY-RUN " + shlex.join(["python", "scripts/gcloud_repo.py", "run", *arguments])


def _url(key: str) -> str:
    return f"gs://{BUCKET}/atlas/web/{key}"


@pytest.fixture()
def staging(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    root = tmp_path / "staging"
    write_staging(root)
    return root


def _publish(staging: Path, *extra: str) -> int:
    return publish.main(["--staging", str(staging), "--bucket", BUCKET, *extra])


def test_dry_run_prints_every_command_and_runs_none(staging: Path, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path / "gcloud", monkeypatch, EMPTY_BUCKET)
    work = (tmp_path / "gz").resolve()
    assert _publish(staging, "--dry-run", "--work-dir", str(work)) == 0
    lines = capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines()
    assert fake.calls() == []
    objects = artifact_objects(staged_catalog())
    surface = next(item for item in objects if ".surface." in item.key)
    size = len((staging / surface.key).read_bytes())
    assert _dry(
        [
            "storage", "cp", str(work / f"{surface.key}.gz"), _url(surface.key),
            "--if-generation-match=0", "--content-encoding=gzip", "--content-type=application/json",
            f"--cache-control={IMMUTABLE_CACHE_CONTROL}",
            '--content-disposition=attachment; filename="hbs-test.surface.json"',
            f"--custom-metadata=sha256={surface.sha256},decoded-bytes={size}",
        ]
    ) in lines
    dry = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("DRY-RUN ")]
    assert len(dry) == 3 * len(objects)  # describe every object, then cp + verify-describe each
    assert dry[: len(objects)] == [_dry(publish.describe_args(_url(item.key))) for item in objects]
    assert not any("--gzip" in line or " rm " in line or "delete" in line for line in lines)
    assert lines[-1] == f"{len(objects)} objects: 0 uploaded, 0 skipped, {len(objects)} planned"


def test_publish_uploads_deterministic_gzip_with_decoded_identity_metadata(staging: Path, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path / "gcloud", monkeypatch, EMPTY_BUCKET)
    assert _publish(staging) == 0
    stored = fake.state()["objects"]
    objects = artifact_objects(staged_catalog())
    assert sorted(stored) == sorted(f"{BUCKET}/atlas/web/{item.key}" for item in objects)
    for item in objects:
        resource = stored[f"{BUCKET}/atlas/web/{item.key}"]
        data = (staging / item.key).read_bytes()
        body = base64.b64decode(resource["data_b64"])
        assert body == gzip.compress(data, compresslevel=9, mtime=0)
        assert hashlib.sha256(gzip.decompress(body)).hexdigest() == item.sha256
        assert resource["metadata"] == {"sha256": item.sha256, "decoded-bytes": str(len(data))}
        assert resource["contentEncoding"] == "gzip"
        assert resource["cacheControl"] == IMMUTABLE_CACHE_CONTROL
        assert resource["contentType"] == item.content_type
        assert resource.get("contentDisposition") == item.content_disposition
    n = len(objects)
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines()[-1] == f"{n} objects: {n} uploaded, 0 skipped, 0 planned"


def test_a_second_publish_skips_every_object(staging: Path, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fake = install_fake_gcloud(tmp_path / "gcloud", monkeypatch, EMPTY_BUCKET)
    assert _publish(staging) == 0
    first = len(fake.calls())
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert _publish(staging) == 0
    second = fake.calls()[first:]
    assert second and all(call[:3] == ["storage", "objects", "describe"] for call in second)
    n = len(artifact_objects(staged_catalog()))
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines()[-1] == f"{n} objects: 0 uploaded, {n} skipped, 0 planned"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(

        ({"contentEncoding": None}, "contentEncoding is None"),
    ],
)
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Publish the Atlas web staging tree to the public GCS bucket (fast-load/GCS design 2026-10-07 §C.2).

Uploads exactly the objects the staging ``catalog.json`` references, at ``atlas/web/<key>``, never
renaming a key. Each file is gzip-compressed here (level 9, mtime 0; never ``--gzip-local*``, which
forces ``Cache-Control: no-transform``) and uploaded with ``--if-generation-match=0``,
``--content-encoding=gzip``, an explicit ``--content-type``, the immutable ``--cache-control``,
``--content-disposition`` for downloads and ``--custom-metadata=sha256=…,decoded-bytes=…``.

Identity is the decoded content recorded in that metadata. Every local file is checked against the
catalog, then every object is described before anything is uploaded: absent → upload; present with
both metadata fields matching and ``contentEncoding: gzip`` → skip; anything else → hard error,
never an overwrite. A 412 on upload gets the same comparison. After an upload the stored metadata,
size and md5 must equal what was sent. Compressed bytes and CRC32C are never compared across runs
(zlib output may differ between builds). ``--dry-run`` prints every command and runs none. Nothing is
ever deleted: cached pages keep referencing old keys. Every command goes through
scripts/gcloud_repo.py.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import tempfile
from collections.abc import Iterator, Mapping, Sequence
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from genomeos.publication.web_layout import (  # noqa: E402
    IMMUTABLE_CACHE_CONTROL,
    WebLayoutError,
    WebObject,
    artifact_objects,
    assert_bucket_name,
    object_name,
)
from scripts.atlas_web_gcloud import Gcloud, GcloudError  # noqa: E402


class PublishError(RuntimeError):
    """Publishing would serve bytes other than the catalog's, or replace a published object."""


def describe_args(url: str) -> list[str]:
    return ["storage", "objects", "describe", url, "--raw", "--format=json"]


def upload_args(source: Path, url: str, item: WebObject, decoded_bytes: int) -> list[str]:
    arguments = [
        "storage",
        "cp",
        str(source),
        url,
        "--if-generation-match=0",
        "--content-encoding=gzip",
        f"--content-type={item.content_type}",
        f"--cache-control={IMMUTABLE_CACHE_CONTROL}",
    ]
    if item.content_disposition is not None:
        arguments.append(f"--content-disposition={item.content_disposition}")
    arguments.append(f"--custom-metadata=sha256={item.sha256},decoded-bytes={decoded_bytes}")
    return arguments


def staged_bytes(staging: Path, item: WebObject) -> bytes:
    path = staging / item.key
    if not path.is_file():
        raise PublishError(f"{item.key}: missing from the staging tree {staging}")
    data = path.read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    if digest != item.sha256:
        raise PublishError(f"{item.key}: staged sha256 {digest} does not match the catalog {item.sha256}")
    if item.decoded_bytes is not None and len(data) != item.decoded_bytes:
        raise PublishError(f"{item.key}: staged size {len(data)} is not the declared {item.decoded_bytes} bytes")
    return data


def identity_problems(existing: Mapping[str, Any], item: WebObject, decoded_bytes: int) -> list[str]:
    metadata = existing.get("metadata") or {}
    problems: list[str] = []
    if metadata.get("sha256") != item.sha256:
        problems.append(f"metadata sha256 is {metadata.get('sha256')!r}, catalog says {item.sha256}")
    if metadata.get("decoded-bytes") != str(decoded_bytes):
        problems.append(f"metadata decoded-bytes is {metadata.get('decoded-bytes')!r}, staged file has {decoded_bytes}")
    if existing.get("contentEncoding") != "gzip":
        problems.append(f"contentEncoding is {existing.get('contentEncoding')!r}, not 'gzip'")
    return problems


def require_identical(url: str, existing: Mapping[str, Any], item: WebObject, decoded_bytes: int) -> None:
    problems = identity_problems(existing, item, decoded_bytes)
    if problems:
        raise PublishError(
            f"refusing to overwrite {url}: {'; '.join(problems)}. Published objects are never replaced "
            "(design §C.2)"
        )


def verify_upload(
    url: str, stored: Mapping[str, Any] | None, item: WebObject, decoded_bytes: int, compressed: bytes
) -> None:
    if stored is None:
        raise PublishError(f"{url}: not found right after upload")
    expected = {
        "size": str(len(compressed)),
        "md5Hash": base64.b64encode(hashlib.md5(compressed, usedforsecurity=False).digest()).decode("ascii"),
        "cacheControl": IMMUTABLE_CACHE_CONTROL,
        "contentType": item.content_type,
        "contentDisposition": item.content_disposition,
    }
    problems = identity_problems(stored, item, decoded_bytes) + [
        f"{field} is {stored.get(field)!r}, expected {value!r}"
        for field, value in expected.items()
        if stored.get(field) != value
    ]
    if problems:
        raise PublishError(
            f"post-upload verification failed for {url}: {'; '.join(problems)}. No deployed catalog "
            f"references it yet; inspect it with `python scripts/gcloud_repo.py run storage objects describe "
            f"{url}` and decide with the owner (it is never overwritten or deleted automatically)"
        )


def publish(staging: Path, bucket: str, gcloud: Gcloud, work_dir: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    catalog = json.loads((staging / "catalog.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    objects = artifact_objects(catalog)
    sizes = {item.key: len(staged_bytes(staging, item)) for item in objects}  # all local checks first
    counts = {"uploaded": 0, "skipped": 0, "planned": 0}
    pending: list[WebObject] = []
    for item in objects:  # every identity is settled before the first upload
        url = f"gs://{bucket}/{object_name(item.key)}"
        existing = gcloud.describe(describe_args(url))
        if existing is None:
            pending.append(item)
            continue
        require_identical(url, existing, item, sizes[item.key])
        counts["skipped"] += 1
        print(f"skipped {item.key} (identical)")
    for item in pending:
        outcome = _upload(staging, bucket, gcloud, work_dir, item)
        counts[outcome] += 1
        print(f"{outcome} {item.key}")
    return counts


def _upload(staging: Path, bucket: str, gcloud: Gcloud, work_dir: Path, item: WebObject) -> str:
    url = f"gs://{bucket}/{object_name(item.key)}"
    data = staged_bytes(staging, item)
    compressed = gzip.compress(data, compresslevel=9, mtime=0)
    source = work_dir / f"{item.key}.gz"
    source.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    source.write_bytes(compressed)
    result = gcloud.mutate(upload_args(source, url, item, len(data)))
    if result.returncode != 0:
        if not result.precondition_failed:
            raise PublishError(f"upload of {url} failed: {result.stderr.strip()}")
        raced = gcloud.describe(describe_args(url))
        if raced is None:
            raise PublishError(f"{url}: the upload precondition failed but the object is absent")
        require_identical(url, raced, item, len(data))
        return "skipped"
    stored = gcloud.describe(describe_args(url))
    if gcloud.dry_run:
        return "planned"
    verify_upload(url, stored, item, len(data), compressed)
    return "uploaded"


@contextmanager
def _work_dir(explicit: Path | None) -> Iterator[Path]:
    if explicit is not None:
        explicit.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        yield explicit.resolve()
        return
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="atlas-web-publish-") as name:
        yield Path(name)


def _bucket(value: str) -> str:
    try:
        return assert_bucket_name(value)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(str(error)) from error


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Publish the Atlas web staging tree to the public GCS bucket.")
    parser.add_argument("--staging", type=Path, required=True, help="tree from encode_atlas_web.py --with-downloads")
    parser.add_argument("--bucket", type=_bucket, required=True, help="bucket name (never stored in git)")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="print every gcloud command and run none")
    parser.add_argument("--work-dir", type=Path, help="where the gzip files are written (default: a temp dir)")
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    gcloud = Gcloud(dry_run=args.dry_run)
    try:
        with _work_dir(args.work_dir) as work_dir:
            counts = publish(args.staging.resolve(), args.bucket, gcloud, work_dir)
    except (PublishError, GcloudError, WebLayoutError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    total = sum(counts.values())
    print(
        f"{total} objects: {counts['uploaded']} uploaded, {counts['skipped']} skipped, "
        f"{counts['planned']} planned"
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```
